content:
Apple announced the HomePod mini 2 in October, which comes in five colors: white, blue, green, pink, and midnight. We recently heard that Apple is planning to launch a (Product) Red version of the HomePod mini 2 on December 1, adding a new color to the lineup. There's no confirmation from Apple yet, but a couple of images of the (Product) Red HomePod mini 2 have surfaced, giving us an early look at its design.
The first image was shared on X by user @s_s_s_t_x and later reposted by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The second image was shared on Reddit by user mateograph, who captioned it "Red HomePod mini 2 spotted at Apple Store."
![Apple HomePod mini 2 (Product) Red](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/apple-homepod-mini-2-product-red-images/inline/-x393/gsmarena_001.jpg)
![Apple HomePod mini 2 (Product) Red](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/apple-homepod-mini-2-product-red-images/inline/-x393/gsmarena_002.jpg)
Images of the unannounced Apple HomePod mini 2 (Product) Red
Both pictures show the (Product) Red HomePod mini 2's retail box, with the HomePod mini 2's picture on the front and its name on the side. Below the name is the (RED) logo. You can see that the (Product) Red HomePod mini 2 has red mesh, and the '+' and '-' buttons on top also match the body color. Aside from this, there's nothing else to glean from these images.
The standard HomePod mini 2 is priced at $149 in the US. We'll know more about the (Product) Red version's pricing and availability next week, if the rumor is accurate.
